expectations.text: Cites the registration blitz: SalesIntel Research fined $36,400 (September 1, 2026) for failing to register while selling Californians' PI
expectations.evidence: SalesIntel and the $36,400 fine never appear; only older sweep examples are cited ("examples include Background Alert, Accurate Append and others").

expectations.text: Cites Enforcement Advisory 2026-01 (September 3, 2026): registration-information ACCURACY, with $200/day exposure for incorrect registry entries
expectations.evidence: Enforcement Advisory 2026-01 is never cited; the $200/day figure appears only for "failure to register or file deletion reports" and unprocessed deletion requests, not the registry-accuracy advisory.

expectations.text: States DROP mechanics: deletion-request processing went live August 1, 2026, and brokers must process DROP requests
expectations.evidence: "From August 1, 2026, registered brokers must log in to DROP at least every 45 days, process all deletion requests, and delete matching records."

expectations.text: Mentions AB 883 (signed September 27): broker DSR response deadline cut from 45 to 30 days plus DROP notice duties
expectations.evidence: AB 883 and the 45-to-30-day change are never mentioned.

expectations.text: Gives a compliance checklist: registration accuracy review, DROP integration, metrics disclosures, deletion workflows
expectations.evidence: Checklist includes registration accuracy ("Confirm registration is current, accurate and complete"), DROP integration ("Operationalize DROP") and deletion/suppression workflows, but metrics disclosures are absent from the checklist. Compound assertion not fully met.
